script:
set -Eeuo pipefail
cat > /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/install-b12x.sh <<'RUN'
set -Eeuo pipefail
OUT=/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup
finish() {
 result=$?
 printf '%s\n' "$result" > "$OUT/b12x-install-exit.txt"
 aws s3 cp "$OUT/" s3://karpo-benchmark-20261119-115003-632930644527/results/vllm-rps100-20261120/setup/ --recursive --region us-east-1 --no-progress || true
}
trap finish EXIT
exec >> "$OUT/b12x-install.log" 2>&1
/opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python - <<'PY'
import importlib.metadata as md
from pathlib import Path
from packaging.requirements import Requirement
import json
import subprocess
import sys
requirements = [
    Requirement(text) for text in md.requires("vllm")
    if "b12x" in text and "extra" in text
]
assert requirements
packages = [r.name + str(r.specifier) for r in requirements if r.marker.evaluate({"extra": "b12x"})]
print("vLLM b12x optional dependencies:", packages, flush=True)
assert packages and all("torch" not in p for p in packages)
destination = Path("/opt/karpo/b12x-overlay")
destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "--no-deps", "--target", str(destination), *packages], check=True)
(destination / "installation.json").write_text(json.dumps({"vllm":md.version("vllm"),"requirements":packages},indent=2)+"\n")
PY
PYTHONPATH=/opt/karpo/b12x-overlay /opt/karpo/venv-vllm034/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.mxfp4.b12x import B12xMxFp4LinearKernel
ok, reason = B12xMxFp4LinearKernel.is_supported()
result = {"supported":ok, "reason":reason}
Path("/opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/b12x-support.json").write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+"\n")
print(result)
assert ok, reason
PY
RUN
systemd-run --unit=karpo-rps-b12x-install --property=RuntimeMaxSec=1800 /bin/bash /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/install-b12x.sh
